title: 4 Years Later, Crunchyroll Finally Confirms the Return of a Major Sports Anime
content: The exciting Summer 2026 anime season is finally here, along with the latest new series and sequels. Most of the new series have yet to make their debut, but as always, they will be streaming on Crunchyroll.
author: ComicBook

title: Frieren Season 3 Confirms Main Staff Ahead of October 2027 Return, New Macht Illustration Revealed
content: Frieren: Beyond the Journey’s End has concluded its Anime Expo 2026 panel with the reveal of the main staff working on Season 3. A special illustration featuring Macht was drawn for the event and shown to the attending fans.
author: Anime Corner

title: Persona 4 Revival Game's Videos Highlight Protagonist, Rise
content: Atlus revealed two new character videos for Persona 4 Revival , a remake of its original 2008 role-playing game, on Friday and Sunday. The first video features the game's protagonist, while the second video features Rise Kujikawa.
author: ANN

title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War - The Calamity Anime Unveils Final Trailer With English Subtitles
content: Viz Media unveiled during its panel at Anime Expo on Saturday the final trailer with English subtitles for Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War - The Calamity , the fourth and final part of the Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War anime.
author: ANN

title: The Ghost in the Shell Anime's 5th Promo Video Reveals King Gnu's Opening Theme
content: Science SARU 's The Ghost in the Shell ( Kōkaku Kidōtai THE GHOST IN THE SHELL ) television anime revealed its fifth promotional video on Sunday. The video previews King Gnu 's opening theme song "Go Ghost." The news was first announced at Anime Expo on Saturday.
author: ANN

title: RWBY Animated Series Greenlights 10th Volume
content: Viz Media announced during its panel at Anime Expo on Saturday that the RWBY animated series has greenlit a 10th volume. The company unveiled a trailer that features the four main characters' voice actresses and showrunner Kerry Shawcross : The original RWBY web animated series by the late creator Monty Oum follows…
author: ANN

title: The Ghost in the Shell by Science SARU Previews Theme Song by King Gnu in Fifth Trailer
content: THE GHOST IN THE SHELL anime by Science SARU revealed a new video introducing the opening theme song by King Gnu. The anime previously confirmed global streaming plans , with Prime Video set to simulcast the anime in Japan and more than 240 countries and territories worldwide.
author: Anime Corner

title: Bleach’s Final Season Drops Awesome Trailer Ahead of July Premiere – Watch Now
content: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War is returning for its final season later this month, and an awesome new trailer has been released showing off a cool look at these final episodes to come.
author: ComicBook

title: Bleach Mirrors High Mobile Game's Trailer Previews 2 Original Player Characters
content: Bandai Namco Entertainment unveiled a new trailer for the Bleach Mirrors High mobile game at Anime Expo on Saturday. The video shows the game's original player characters Shirin Migishima and Shirane Sanari, who are both designed by original Bleach manga creator Tite Kubo .
author: ANN

title: MangaGamer Releases Rose Guns Days Visual Novel's Season 2 on July 30
content: MangaGamer announced on Friday at Anime Expo that it will release the second season of its new edition of 07th Expansion 's Rose Guns Days visual novel series on MangaGamer and Steam on July 30. The release features updated graphics, as well as Japanese, English, and Chinese language options.
author: ANN
